clue.text: At the top of the stairs, and coming down

definitions.text: At the top of the stairs
definitions.meaning: the flat floor area where a flight of steps ends
an aircraft's arrival on the ground

explanation.definitionFit: The noun names the platform reached at a staircase's head, and the verbal form describes an aircraft touching down.

clue.text: The girl may turn out to be brighter

indicators.note: the words before turn out, when rearranged, to be something else, so their letters are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A young woman's character may prove sunnier than expected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may turn out to be' signals a rearrangement of THE GIRL.
explanation.definitionFit: Something emitting more light or paler in colour is more brilliant, a comparative synonym.

clue.text: Not the motto of those enjoying a challenging puzzle!

definitions.text: Not the motto of those enjoying a challenging puzzle!

parts.words: Not the motto of those enjoying a challenging puzzle!
parts.note: the idiom for a harmonious relationship with no quarrels, punned on as if about the puzzles solvers love, which they would hardly forswear

explanation.surface: Puzzle fans would hardly adopt this as their slogan.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes a couple who never argue, read literally as never doing a grid puzzle.

clue.text: One has to back up a little bit

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I

indicators.note: in a down clue, backing up means the word to is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone must reverse a short distance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back up' turns TO into OT, sitting after I and before A.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek letter's name is used idiomatically for a tiny amount.

clue.text: Explosive old ruler with a need to reform

parts.note: GR stands for Georgius Rex, King George

indicators.note: to reform means to shape anew, so the letters of a need are rearranged

explanation.surface: A volatile former monarch who must change his ways.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to reform' rearranges A NEED to make ENADE, placed after GR.
explanation.definitionFit: A hand-thrown bomb is an explosive device; the clue uses the word as a noun.

clue.text: Performers' bad posture

definitions.note: the possessive is read as 'Performers is': the plural noun names acting companies

indicators.note: bad suggests the letters of posture are in a poor, disordered state

explanation.surface: Stage artists stand with poor deportment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' signals a rearrangement of POSTURE; the apostrophe in Performers' stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Companies of touring actors or dancers are groups of entertainers.

clue.text: In the main this will ensure a net gain

definitions.text: In the main this will ensure a net gain

parts.words: In the main this will ensure a net gain
parts.note: the main is the open sea, and the net gain is a catch hauled in, not a financial profit

explanation.surface: A business plan that guarantees profit after costs.
explanation.definitionFit: A fishing boat dragging a large net across the sea gathers a catch.

clue.text: A sign of love, guys!

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O
guys means men

explanation.surface: An affectionate signal addressed to some chaps.
explanation.definitionFit: A portent is a sign of something to come.

clue.text: Legal authority is a lawyer's strength

definitions.meaning: a formal right granted to act on another's behalf
read literally: the might of an attorney

explanation.definitionFit: The document grants delegated authority, and literally names the might of a legal representative.

clue.text: Toss the head, showing a lack of confidence

parts.note: to shy something is to throw it
a ness is a headland, as in Loch Ness or Sheerness

explanation.surface: Flicking one's hair back, betraying nervousness.
explanation.definitionFit: Timidity is a lack of self-assurance.

clue.text: Let the other side win, causing split

definitions.meaning: to lose deliberately, throwing a match
slang for informing or revealing a secret

explanation.surface: Deliberately losing a match causes a rift in the team.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to reveal a hidden plan, and literally to hand victory to opponents.

clue.text: Blue wanting to play outside right

indicators.note: outside means the word for play wraps round the letter for right

parts.note: to toy is to play

explanation.surface: A sad person who doesn't want to play on the right wing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' puts TOY around R. Blue is the British Conservative Party's colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Blue is the colour of Britain's Conservatives, so it stands for a Conservative supporter.

clue.text: Underhand about publicity, unfortunately

indicators.note: about means the word for underhand goes round the word for publicity

parts.note: sly means underhand or sneaky
an ad is a piece of publicity

explanation.surface: Regrettably, there was something devious about the promotion.
explanation.definitionFit: Regrettably is a synonym, an adverb expressing sorrow.

clue.text: Gold and iron fish

parts.note: or is heraldic gold
Fe is the chemical symbol for iron

explanation.surface: A metallic-looking fish of gold and iron.
explanation.definitionFit: The ide, a freshwater carp-family fish, has this alternative name.

clue.text: Person writing sound article

parts.note: a hum is a low sound
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Someone composing an article that is well reasoned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' looks like an adjective meaning reliable; it is a noun giving HUM. 'writing' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of our species is an individual.

clue.text: At the side of a supporter

parts.note: a beam is a structural support

explanation.surface: Standing beside someone who backs you.
explanation.definitionFit: Nautically it means level with a ship's side, at right angles to the keel.

clue.text: He needs a good hiding!

parts.note: a good hiding sounds like a thrashing, but means a secure place to stay out of sight

explanation.surface: A naughty boy deserves a beating.
explanation.definitionFit: A hermit withdraws from society and so wants a place to stay concealed.

clue.text: Checks polish in reserve

indicators.note: in places the word for polish inside the abbreviation for reserve

parts.note: to buff is to polish

explanation.surface: Inspects polish kept back as a reserve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts BUFF inside RES. 'Checks' is a verb here.
explanation.definitionFit: Snubs or repulses halt an advance, so they hold it back.

clue.text: Raising a crop is commonplace

indicators.note: raising lifts and stirs up the letters of a crop is, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Growing crops is an ordinary activity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Raising' signals a rearrangement of A CROP IS.
explanation.definitionFit: Dull and unimaginative, so mundane.

clue.text: Railing when on edge

parts.note: railing sounds like ranting when nervous, but means a protective barrier along a drop

explanation.surface: Someone ranting when their nerves are frayed.
explanation.definitionFit: A low protective wall along a roof or bridge sits at the drop.

clue.text: Delude kind associate

parts.note: to con is to delude
sort means kind

explanation.surface: Fooling a generous colleague.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep company with someone is to associate with them.

clue.text: Added note to change a book

parts.note: PS, postscript, is a note added to a letter
to alter is to change

explanation.surface: Appending a remark to revise a volume.
explanation.definitionFit: A volume of the Psalms is a biblical book.

clue.text: A tool for the use of princes

indicators.note: the letters of princes are put to another use, rearranged into a new word

explanation.surface: An instrument reserved for royalty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for the use of' signals a rearrangement of PRINCES.
explanation.definitionFit: A gripping implement with two jaws is a hand tool.

clue.text: Auburn-haired leader of the leftist party?

definitions.meaning: describes a person with reddish hair, standing for such a person
read literally: a red is a leftist, and the head is its leader

explanation.definitionFit: A person with reddish hair has this name, and literally a chief of the Reds.

clue.text: The others take things easy

explanation.definitionFit: The noun means the remainder, and the verb means to relax.

clue.text: Getting in a heartless nurse is stupid

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: heartless removes the middle of nurse, leaving its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Admitting an unfeeling nurse is a foolish act.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' leaves NE, the first and last letters of NURSE. 'Getting' and 'is' only link.
explanation.definitionFit: Silly and pointless, so foolish.

clue.text: A state of mind that can bring about ruin

indicators.note: bring about means turn round, so the letters of the word for ruin are rearranged

parts.note: doom means ruin

explanation.surface: Depression can lead to someone's downfall.
explanation.definitionFit: A temper or frame of feeling is a mental state.

clue.text: A direction about parking at the east end of the church

definitions.text: the east end of the church

parts.note: P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking
SE, south-east, is a compass direction

explanation.surface: Signs to the car park at the east end of the church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts SE around P, after A.
explanation.definitionFit: A vaulted recess at a church's eastern end, behind the altar.

clue.text: Rubbish in a tip is cumulative

indicators.note: in tells us the letters are found inside the words is cumulative

explanation.surface: Waste piling up at a dump.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' shows the answer sitting inside 'iS CUMulative'.
explanation.definitionFit: Froth or filth on a surface is worthless refuse.

clue.text: Faint light of morning star caught in oriental picture

parts.note: Phosphor is a poetic name for Venus as the morning star
E for eastern

indicators.note: in places the letter for caught inside the word for picture

parts.note: a scene is a picture
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A dim glow of Venus captured in an Eastern painting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts C inside SCENE to make SCENCE.
explanation.definitionFit: A glow emitted without heat, as by some sea creatures, is a dim luminescence.

clue.text: Most well-organised flier seen clutching passes

indicators.note: clutching means the word for flier holds the word for passes inside it

parts.note: a tit is a small bird, a flier
dies is a euphemism, passes away

explanation.surface: The neatest bird spotted gripping its travel tickets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clutching' puts TIT around DIES. 'Passes' means dies, not tickets.
explanation.definitionFit: Neatest or most orderly is a superlative synonym.

clue.text: Some day possibly getting a dog

indicators.note: possibly suggests the letters of some day could be arranged differently

explanation.surface: Perhaps one day we will get a pet.
explanation.definitionFit: A white, fluffy Siberian breed is a kind of dog.
